query:
SELECT
            i.value AS matched_value,
            iorr.source,
            iorr.confidence,
            iorr.first_seen,
            iorr.last_seen,
            r.id AS "report_id?",
            r.title AS report_title,
            r.url AS report_url
        FROM indicator i
        JOIN indicator_observed_in_report iorr ON iorr.indicator_id = i.id
        JOIN report r ON r.id = iorr.report_id
        WHERE i.kind = 'path'
          AND $1 ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(i.value, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
        LIMIT $2
